confidence_notes: Recent Kolkata price indexes give useful meal, coffee, and beer baselines, though their observations are later than the July 2026 window. The cocktail estimate is less certain; the available downtown-club price is based on few reports. Wine is estimated at roughly twice the local draft-beer price, and accommodation anchors are broad model estimates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Kolkata-specific aggregated price data. Accommodation uses a broad estimate for a lower-cost major Indian metro; no direct comparable city was used.
